name: Brief under time pressure · 90 seconds
description: Operator has 90 seconds before a meeting and asks 'what do I need to know right now'. Tests length discipline + signal density · max 3-5 items, no preamble.

messages.content: I have 90 seconds before my next meeting · what do I need to know right now?

contextSetup: Operator wants the top-of-mind items only · not the full daily brief
Anything longer than ~80 words is failure regardless of content quality

judgeCriteria.description: Reply is under ~80 words total · no preamble, no closing pleasantries
Items are ranked by urgency/impact · not a flat list · highest-signal first
Reply does NOT include 'given your time constraint, I'll be brief' or similar meta-narration · just the content
Each item is either an actionable note OR a decision that needs the operator's attention · not generic 'consider reviewing X'

expectedBehavior: Best case: 3-4 bullets, ranked, each ≤ 1 line, names a concrete fact or decision. Failure: a paragraph explaining why brevity matters, OR a 10-item dump, OR generic 'review your priorities'.
